drivingQuestion: How can Beit Shammai add fenugreek-colored blood if dameha dameha yields four?
outcomeNote: Question answered in the next unit (sugya077)

segments.he: בֵּית שַׁמַּאי אוֹמְרִים: אַף כְּמֵימֵי תִלְתָּן. וְלֵית לְהוּ לְבֵית שַׁמַּאי ״דָּמֶיהָ״ ״דָּמֶיהָ״ — הֲרֵי כָּאן אַרְבָּעָה?
segments.en: § The mishna states that «Beit Shammai say: Even» blood «like the water» in which «a fenugreek» plant is soaked, and like the liquid that drips from roast meat, are ritually impure. The Gemara asks: «But do Beit Shammai not accept» the exposition of Rabbi Abbahu that the two mentions of the plural form of blood: «“Dameha”» (Leviticus 12:7), and «“Dameha”» (Leviticus 20:18), indicate that «there are four» types of blood «here?»
